title: A Multi-Method Analysis of Students' Experience During a Simulated Compliance Scenario: Behavior, Cognition, and Emotion
summary: After an experimental simulation study examining obedience to authority in Advanced Care Paramedic (n=19) and Respiratory Therapy Students (n=40) debriefing interviews were conducted to further understand student experiences. The semi-structured interviews were focused on Impression Management, Moral Distress, and Displacement of Responsibility. A multi-method analytic approach was taken. The results support the experimental findings and observations of the simulated scenario, while providing further insight to behaviour, cognition, and emotion. Challenging authority can be difficult and there are multiple influences on students’ behaviour. Impression Management, Moral Distress, and Displacement of Responsibility were all influential on student behaviour to varying degrees. During the interview additional findings emerged related to memory and perception, effects of previous experience, and professional and cultural influences. Implications for education and simulation studies were derived including: the use of simulation to provide experience challenging authority, tools for speaking up, and various tactics to improve education on speaking up.

标题：模拟依从情境下学生体验的多方法分析：行为、认知与情绪
摘要：在一项考察高级护理辅助人员（n=19）与呼吸治疗专业学生（n=40）服从权威的实验模拟研究之后，研究者开展了事后访谈，以进一步理解学生的体验。半结构化访谈聚焦于印象管理、道德困境与责任转移。研究采用多方法分析路径。结果支持实验发现及对模拟情境的观察，同时进一步揭示行为、认知与情绪方面的洞见。挑战权威可能较为困难，且学生行为受到多重因素影响。印象管理、道德困境与责任转移均在不同程度上影响学生行为。访谈中还涌现出与记忆和感知、既往经历的影响以及专业与文化影响相关的额外发现。研究得出了对教育与模拟研究的启示，包括：运用模拟提供挑战权威的体验、用于发声的工具，以及改进发声教育的多种策略。
关键词：服从权威；印象管理；道德困境；责任转移；模拟研究

title: Cross-modal perception of human emotion in domestic horses (Equus caballus)
summary: AbstractHumans have domesticated many kinds of animals in their history. Dogs and horses have particularly close relationships with humans as cooperative partners. However, fewer scientific studies have been conducted on cognition in horses compared to dogs. Studies have shown that horses cross-modally distinguish human facial expressions and recognize familiar people, which suggests that they also cross-modally distinguish human emotions. In the present study, we used the expectancy violation method to investigate whether horses cross-modally perceive human emotions. Horses were shown a picture of a human facial expression on a screen, and they then heard a human voice from the speaker before the screen. The emotional values of the visual and auditory stimuli were the same in the congruent condition and different in the incongruent condition. Horses looked at the speaker significantly longer in the incongruent condition than in the congruent condition when they heard their caretaker’s voices but not when they heard the stranger voice. In addition, they responded significantly more quickly to the voice in the incongruent condition than in the congruent one. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to show that horses cross-modally recognized the emotional states of their caretakers and strangers.

相关性：是
标题：家马对人类情绪的跨模态感知
摘要：人类在历史上驯化了多种动物，狗和马作为合作伴侣与人类关系尤为密切。然而，与狗相比，关于马认知能力的科学研究较少。已有研究表明，马能够跨模态区分人类面部表情并识别熟悉的人，这提示它们可能也能跨模态区分人类情绪。本研究采用预期违背范式，探究马是否能跨模态感知人类情绪。实验中，马先在屏幕上看到一张人类面部表情图片，随后听到屏幕前方扬声器传出的人声。一致条件下视觉与听觉刺激的情绪效价相同，不一致条件下则不同。结果显示，当马听到其饲养员的声音时，在不一致条件下的注视扬声器时间显著长于一致条件，而听到陌生人声音时则无此差异；此外，马在不一致条件下对声音的反应速度显著快于一致条件。据我们所知，本研究首次证明马能够跨模态识别其饲养员和陌生人的情绪状态。
关键词：跨模态感知；人类情绪；家马；面部表情；预期违背范式

title: Calibrating Use of Emotion Regulation Strategies to the Relationship Context: An Attachment Perspective
summary: AbstractThis research tested whether adult attachment orientations predict use of emotion regulation strategies in theoretically consistent ways, and whether associations among attachment orientations and emotion regulatory strategies are moderated by critical features of the relationship context. Ninety‐six couples (192 individuals) reported on their attachment orientations, habitual use of emotion regulation strategies (cognitive reappraisal, expressive suppression, negative emotion expressivity), and perceptions of relationship closeness and negative partner behaviors. Highly secure individuals reported greater use of cognitive reappraisal, especially when they felt closer to their partners, and engaged in less suppression when their partners behaved more negatively toward them. Highly avoidant individuals reported greater use of suppression, especially when they perceived more negative partner behaviors, and when their partners were more avoidant. Highly anxious individuals also used more suppression when their partners were more avoidant, but they expressed more negative emotions when they were paired with less avoidant partners. Fearful‐avoidant individuals' emotion regulation patterns resembled those of both highly secure and dismissive‐avoidant individuals. This study illustrates how attending to moderating effects within specific relationships and testing joint effects of both partners' personality characteristics can help identify contextual boundaries of emotion regulation strategies and clarify emotional response patterns in couples.

标题：依据关系情境校准情绪调节策略的使用：依恋视角
摘要：本研究检验了成人依恋取向是否能以理论上一致的方式预测情绪调节策略的使用，以及依恋取向与情绪调节策略之间的关联是否受到关系情境关键特征的调节。96对伴侣（192名个体）报告了其依恋取向、情绪调节策略的习惯性使用（认知重评、表达抑制、负性情绪表达性）以及对关系亲密性和伴侣负性行为的感知。高安全型个体报告更多使用认知重评，尤其是在感到与伴侣更亲密时；当伴侣对其行为更消极时，他们较少使用抑制。高回避型个体报告更多使用抑制，尤其是在感知到更多伴侣负性行为时，以及当其伴侣更回避时。高焦虑型个体在伴侣更回避时也更多使用抑制，但当与较少回避的伴侣配对时，他们表达更多负性情绪。恐惧-回避型个体的情绪调节模式类似于高安全型和漠视-回避型个体。本研究说明，关注特定关系中的调节效应并检验双方人格特征的联合效应，有助于识别情绪调节策略的情境边界，并澄清伴侣中的情绪反应模式。
关键词：依恋取向；情绪调节策略；关系情境；认知重评；表达抑制

标题：执行功能与情绪调节在抑郁和焦虑障碍中的关系：一项横断面研究
摘要：背景：执行功能（EF）和情绪调节（ER）缺陷在抑郁和焦虑障碍中普遍存在，提示其具有跨诊断作用。鉴于二者在治疗参与、症状减轻和复发预防中的作用，本研究考察这些障碍中EF与ER的相互关系。方法：参与者（n=27例抑郁/焦虑障碍患者，n=27名非临床对照组）接受精神科筛查及症状严重程度、EF（任务转换、反应抑制[RI]、工作记忆[WM]、言语流畅性、计划）和ER（严重程度、策略、情绪诱发后的情境性ER）评估。采用Mann–Whitney U检验/t检验进行组间比较，采用Pearson/Spearman检验进行相关分析。结果：临床组表现出较低的工作记忆（Cohen's d=0.94，p=.001）、言语流畅性（Cohen's d=0.7，p=.01）和反应抑制（Cohen's d=0.35，p=.02）；更大的情绪调节困难（Cohen's d=−1.40，p<.001）、更多使用灾难化这一消极ER策略（Cohen's d=0.55，p<.001）；在情绪诱发任务中——更多使用接纳、他人责备，但无积极重评。非临床组更多使用重新聚焦于计划这一积极ER策略（Cohen's d=0.53，p<.001），且在情绪诱发任务中未使用反刍。ER困难严重程度与较差的工作记忆相关（p=.006）；接纳作为ER策略与较差的反应抑制相关（p=.02）。抑郁/焦虑组的EF和ER困难及适应不良策略显著更高。结论：本研究结果拓展了既往研究，为定制化干预提供了可操作的见解，值得在更大样本中验证。较差的工作记忆与更大的ER困难相关，低效的反应抑制与被动接纳相关，认知训练等干预可能增强ER。

title: Horses Categorize Human Emotions Cross-Modally Based on Facial Expression and Non-Verbal Vocalizations
summary: Over the last few years, an increasing number of studies have aimed to gain more insight into the field of animal emotions. In particular, it is of interest to determine whether animals can cross-modally categorize the emotions of others. For domestic animals that share a close relationship with humans, we might wonder whether this cross-modal recognition of emotions extends to humans, as well. In this study, we tested whether horses could recognize human emotions and attribute the emotional valence of visual (facial expression) and vocal (non-verbal vocalization) stimuli to the same perceptual category. Two animated pictures of different facial expressions (anger and joy) were simultaneously presented to the horses, while a speaker played an emotional human non-verbal vocalization matching one of the two facial expressions. Horses looked at the picture that was incongruent with the vocalization more, probably because they were intrigued by the paradoxical combination. Moreover, horses reacted in accordance with the valence of the vocalization, both behaviorally and physiologically (heart rate). These results show that horses can cross-modally recognize human emotions and react emotionally to the emotional states of humans, assessed by non-verbal vocalizations.

标题：马基于面部表情和非言语发声跨模态分类人类情绪
摘要：过去几年中，越来越多的研究致力于深入探讨动物情绪领域。 particularly，确定动物是否能跨模态分类他人情绪备受关注。对于与人类关系密切的家养动物，我们可能会思考这种情绪的跨模态识别是否也延伸至人类。本研究测试了马是否能识别人类情绪，并将视觉（面部表情）和听觉（非言语发声）刺激的情绪效价归入同一知觉类别。研究同时向马呈现两张不同面部表情（愤怒和喜悦）的动画图片，同时通过扬声器播放与其中一种面部表情匹配的人类情绪非言语发声。马更多地注视与发声不匹配的图片，可能是因为它们对这种矛盾组合感到好奇。此外，马在行为和行为生理（心率）上均按照发声的效价作出反应。这些结果表明，马能够跨模态识别人类情绪，并对人类情绪状态作出情绪性反应，该反应通过非言语发声进行评估。
关键词：跨模态识别；人类情绪；面部表情；非言语发声；马

title: Cognitive Reappraisal and Expressive Suppression Evoke Distinct Neural Connections during Interpersonal Emotion Regulation
summary:
Interpersonal emotion regulation is the dynamic process where the regulator aims to change the target's emotional state, which is presumed to engage three neural systems: cognitive control (i.e., dorsal and ventral lateral PFC, etc.), empathy/social cognition (i.e., dorsal premotor regions, temporal-parietal junction, etc.), and affective response (i.e., insula, amygdala, etc.). This study aimed to identify the underlying neural correlate (especially the interpersonal one), of interpersonal emotion regulation based on two typical strategies (cognitive appraisal, expressive suppression). Thirty-four female dyads (friends) were randomly assigned into two strategy groups, with one assigned as the target and the other as the regulator to downregulate the target's negative emotions using two strategies. A functional near-infrared spectroscopy system was used to simultaneously measure participants' neural activity. Results showed that these two strategies could successfully downregulate the targets' negative emotions. Both strategies evoked intrapersonal and interpersonal neural couplings between the cognitive control, social cognition, and mirror neuron systems (e.g., PFC, temporal-parietal junction, premotor cortex, etc.), whereas cognitive reappraisal (vs expressive suppression) evoked a broader pattern. Further, cognitive reappraisal involved increased interpersonal brain synchronization between the prefrontal and temporal areas at the sharing stage, whereas expressive suppression evoked increased interpersonal brain synchronization associated with the PFC at the regulation stage. These findings indicate that intrapersonal and interpersonal neural couplings associated with regions within the abovementioned systems, possibly involving mental processes, such as cognitive control, mentalizing, and observing, underlie interpersonal emotion regulation based on cognitive reappraisal or expressive suppression.
                  
                    SIGNIFICANCE STATEMENT
                    As significant as intrapersonal emotion regulation, interpersonal emotion regulation subserves parent–child, couple, and leader–follower relationships. Despite enormous growth in research on intrapersonal emotion regulation, the field lacks insight into the neural correlates underpinning interpersonal emotion regulation. This study aimed to probe the underlying neural correlates of interpersonal emotion regulation using a multibrain neuroimaging (i.e., hyperscanning) based on functional near-infrared spectroscopy. Results showed that both cognitive reappraisal and expressive suppression strategies successfully downregulated the target's negative emotions. More importantly, they evoked intrapersonal and interpersonal neural couplings associated with regions within the cognitive control, social cognition, and mirror neuron systems, possibly involving mental processes, such as cognitive control, mentalizing, and observing. These findings deepen our understanding of the neural correlates underpinning interpersonal emotion regulation.

相关性：是
标题：认知重评与表达抑制在人际情绪调节中引发不同的神经连接
摘要：人际情绪调节是调节者旨在改变目标者情绪状态的动态过程，据推测涉及三个神经系统：认知控制（即背侧和腹侧外侧前额叶皮层等）、共情/社会认知（即背侧前运动区、颞顶联合区等）以及情感反应（即岛叶、杏仁核等）。本研究旨在基于两种典型策略（认知重评、表达抑制）识别人际情绪调节的潜在神经关联（尤其是人际层面的神经关联）。34对女性配对（朋友）被随机分配到两个策略组，其中一人被指定为目标者，另一人被指定为调节者，使用两种策略下调目标者的负性情绪。采用功能性近红外光谱系统同时测量参与者的神经活动。结果表明，这两种策略均能成功下调目标者的负性情绪。两种策略均引发了认知控制、社会认知和镜像神经元系统（如前额叶皮层、颞顶联合区、前运动皮层等）相关的个体内和人际神经耦合，而认知重评（相较于表达抑制）引发了更广泛的模式。此外，认知重评在分享阶段涉及前额叶与颞叶区域之间人际脑同步的增加，而表达抑制在调节阶段引发了与前额叶皮层相关的人际脑同步增加。这些发现表明，上述系统内区域相关的个体内和人际神经耦合——可能涉及认知控制、心理化和观察等心理过程——是认知重评或表达抑制基础上人际情绪调节的神经基础。
关键词：人际情绪调节；认知重评；表达抑制；人际脑同步；功能性近红外光谱
